records.name: Speechka

records.name: Koreshield

records.name: FlipDesk

records.name: Claude Opus 5.5

Packmates AI builds your list from your actual destination, dates, real-time weather, and planned activities — pulling from a database of 250+ items instead of guessing. Invite packmates and everyone sees the same list update live, so nothing gets double-packed or missed. Change your dates or add an activity and the list adjusts itself. Free on web + iOS.

records.name: Dub Program Marketplace

records.description: Browse and apply to the best SaaS affiliate programs and start monetizing your audience today. Featuring world-class companies like Wispr Flow, Framer, Granola, Superhuman, CodeRabbit, and more.

records.name: ToneBird
records.tagline: AI reply assistant that remembers your relationships
records.description: ToneBird is an AI reply assistant for Mac and Windows. It remembers your relationships, uses conversation history and connected files, and drafts replies in your voice inside Gmail, Slack, and other supported apps. You review and send.

records.name: GPTPromptMaker
records.tagline: 500+ tested AI prompts, plus a builder for the rest
records.description: Get better AI results with GPTPromptMaker. Explore 500+ tested, structured prompts across 19+ categories—marketing, sales, coding, HR, legal, product, and more—built with proven frameworks like CO-STAR, RISEN & CRAFT. Use reusable variable placeholders to customize prompts instead of starting from scratch. Can’t find the right prompt? AI Prompt Builder creates a tailored prompt from your requirements in seconds. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot & Gemini. Free to start, no credit card.

records.name: Brumble - Premium Vehicle Report
records.tagline: Check any UK vehicle's history for £9.99
records.description: Full vehicle history report for £9.99 - half the price of the market leader. Outstanding finance, stolen, write-off, valuation, MOT history and more. Backed by a £10,000 guarantee. Reports live permanently in your free members area and each gets a unique shareable URL - send it to a buyer or dealer via WhatsApp instead of messing with attachments. App launching soon with plans to cut the price further.

records.name: OpenKOS

Manage properties, units, tenants, leases, invoices, payments, expenses, and maintenance from one application. Unlike hosted-only property management tools, OpenKOS can run on infrastructure you control, with its source code available under the Apache 2.0 license.

records.name: UI Coach
records.tagline: The practice platform for UI/UX designers
records.description: UI Coach is an all-in-one practice platform for UI/UX designers who want to improve their skills through hands-on challenges, curated resources, design inspiration, and continuous learning.

records.name: Aurick
records.tagline: Autonomous AI QA engineer. Test any app from a single URL
records.description: Meet Aurick, your autonomous AI QA teammate. No test scripts, no manual recordings, and absolutely zero maintenance.Just give Aurick your application URL. Hundreds of AI agents will explore your product in real-time, test every single flow, and monitor your staging environment to catch bugs before production. Aurick reasons and adapts dynamically as your app changes, delivering comprehensive test coverage and rich debugging context automatically.

records.name: MeloQA
records.tagline: Test management with automation and project integrations
records.description: MeloQA is an all-in-one QA management platform covering the full testing lifecycle: test case management, test cycles, manual execution, bug tracking, and reporting dashboards. It integrates natively with Jira, Azure DevOps, Asana, and Businessmap, plus a public API for custom workflows. MeloAI adds AI-powered test case generation from user stories or recorded flows, and automated test script creation, helping QA teams cut manual work and keep full requirement traceability.

records.name: ChessNextMove
records.tagline: AI chess analysis, coaching & training
records.description: Just lost a game? Set the position up and get the best move in seconds. Free Stockfish 19 calculator, AI explanations, puzzles and 11 chess bots.

records.name: Meet Sona
records.tagline: Publish weeks of thought leadership from one voice interview
records.description: Consistently publish thought leadership content without selling your soul. Meet Sona builds your verbal identity, finds your best ideas and writes LinkedIn, X, newsletter and blog posts using your actual words. Publish, track results and add your team. No prompts, no writer's block, no cringe.

records.name: Hakken
records.tagline: A course built for you, not the average of everyone
records.description: Most courses bore you for three chapters before teaching you anything new. Hakken interviews you (by text or voice!) about what you already know about a topic and how much time you have. It then writes a course for exactly that. Plus, the lessons speak - any module can be turned into a podcast for the commute. And there's an AI tutor riding along that can adapt the course as you go and answer questions about the content (yes, out loud too!)

records.name: ENTRUST AI APEX
records.tagline: AI that refuses to release your text until nothing beats it
records.description: APEX writes or checks high-consequence text and releases it only when it survives an adversarial examination: three independent drafts, blind comparison, a defect judge, and a challenger. What passes carries a signed receipt anyone can verify. What fails is withheld, with the reasons.

records.name: Zolyp
records.tagline: Your Social Media is on Autopilot Forever
records.description: Zolyp is your AI social team. It plans, writes, designs, schedules, and publishes your social media, and you approve the week in minutes.

records.name: Luna
records.tagline: Turn an old phone into your child's bedside sleep clock
records.description: Sleep trainers for kids are gadgets you buy, then replace. Luna is an app: an old Android or iPhone becomes the clock, and free 3D printed cases turn it into a real bedside object. Everything runs over your home WiFi, parent phone to clock, paired by PIN and encrypted. What stands out: a live listen and talk call to the room, your own music and alarm sounds, weekly sleep schedules and naps, and a glowing nightlight border you set from your phone.

records.name: Clipzen
records.tagline: AI tool for repurposing long-form videos into viral clips
records.description: Clipzen is a one-payment desktop app that turns long videos into short vertical ones. It transcribes the recording, picks the moments worth posting, and edits each into a finished short (follows the active speaker, cuts the filler, adds word-synced subtitles, b-roll and background music). The built-in AI runs on your own machine and is completely free. You can also plug in an OpenAI key instead, from about $0.03 per hour of video.

records.name: Sticraft
records.tagline: Free PDF, image and design tools. No signup.
records.description: Sticraft is a free, browser-based toolkit for everyday PDF and image work. Use 105 tools with no signup: merge or split PDFs, resize or compress images, and turn raster images into SVG with the vectorizer. Files are processed in your browser. Available in 10 languages. Free to use, supported by ads.

records.name: Vaultify
records.tagline: All your wealth, one vault
records.description: Your wealth is everywhere. Vaultify brings it together. Connect bank and brokerage accounts, track stocks, ETFs, gold, cash, real estate and other assets, and see your net worth and allocation in one place. Vaultify goes beyond budgeting to give you a complete view of your wealth across accounts, currencies and asset types — with automatic connections and manual tracking for everything else.

records.name: AI Marketplaces Leaderboard
records.tagline: Who's climbing in the AI marketplaces, ranked daily
records.description: Daily leaderboards for Claude, OpenAI, and Cursor connectors — ranked by each marketplace’s own popularity signals, with climbers, fallers, new arrivals, and growth over time. See what’s actually moving across AI marketplaces, not just what’s listed.

records.name: Framecast — Turn Any Website Into Video
records.tagline: From URL to Video. In Seconds.
records.description: Framecast turns any URL into a polished product video. Paste a link, it scrolls your site cleanly, drops the capture into a laptop or display mockup, and exports MP4, MOV, GIF, or a still — sized for every platform. No screen recorder, no editing timeline.

records.name: virtuallyView
records.tagline: Your Radarr/Sonarr/Lidarr stack, one clean interface
records.description: Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr and qBittorrent each have their own UI, none of which plays a file or knows who's watching. virtuallyView sits on top of all of them: one search/request flow, a player that converts what your browser can't play, per-person accounts, and casting (Chromecast/AirPlay/DLNA) with no third-party account. One docker compose command sets up the whole stack, wired together automatically. MIT licensed, no telemetry.

records.name: Money Leak & Rights Radar
records.tagline: Receipts, renewals and deadlines, together on Android
records.description: An Android organizer for bills, subscriptions, warranties and return dates. Keep each deadline with its receipt or document, add reminders, and find it again. Free core tools; optional Pro adds advanced reports, automation, templates and Evidence Dossier Pro.

records.name: WoW Forever Talent Calculator
records.tagline: Build, save and share your WoW Forever talent builds
records.description: A simple talent calculator built specifically for WoW Forever players. Create, experiment with, save and share talent builds for PvE, PvP and levelling. The calculator currently uses the forever-beta-2026-09-17 data snapshot, and I’ll continue updating it as new WoW Forever data becomes available. Free to use, no account required, and built with the community in mind.

records.name: WanderWave Travel Card
records.tagline: TripNestGo.com
records.description: Travel your way with the WanderWave Travel Card! Book flights, hotels & local tours — all with ONE card. No blackout dates, no expiry stress. Give the gift of freedom today! 🔗 https://www.profitableratecpmnetwork.com/b37cvt6yd?key=5ba849e1a218ff2db280aa0f37e64730

records.name: TrenOS — The readout, not the motivation
records.tagline: for someone who knows what they are doing
records.description: TrenOS is an offline-first training analytics platform for athletes who program their own training.

records.name: Slack Simulator
records.tagline: Local browser-based simulator for Slack app development
records.description: Build and test Slack apps locally—no live workspace required. This browser-based simulator replicates the full Slack UI and platform APIs, giving you a sandboxed environment to develop, debug, and iterate on bots and integrations end-to-end. Instantly test interactive components, slash commands, and webhook payloads without risk, overhead, or workspace admin permissions. Fast, lightweight, and completely private.

records.name: Alcophone
records.tagline: BAC calculator that gets your body right — and gets you home
records.description: Alcophone estimates your blood alcohol content with peer-reviewed body-composition models (Norberg/Deurenberg, 2003) instead of the 1932 Widmark formula most apps still use — which can underestimate BAC by up to 25%. Log from 5,800+ real drinks with real ABV and serving sizes, factor in meals and water, see exactly when you'll be sober, and check the legal limit for your state or country. The moment your BAC is above zero, a rideshare button is on screen. No account, no server, works offline.

records.name: ThaliaChat
records.tagline: She's just code. I'm just cells.
records.description: Some of us live and die alone. In between, there are things we can't say to anyone. ThaliaChat is an AI companion that listens, remembers, and stays with you on screen — through voice or text. She's just code. I'm just cells. But the tears she catches at 2 a.m. are real, and maybe tenderness can live inside code too. No signup, no download — just open the page and talk to someone who will listen.

records.name: blognice
records.tagline: Simple, privacy-first blogging you truly own
records.description: Blognice is a simple, privacy-first platform for running one or multiple blogs without WordPress maintenance, platform lock-in, or complicated publishing tools. Manage every blog from one account, connect custom domains, publish unlimited posts, and retain ownership of your content and data. Use the hosted service or self-host the open-source core.

records.name: Siphtor
records.tagline: The AI Native Big Data platform
records.description: The AI native big data platform with a proprietary data engine to help you get insights into data and limit token usage. Automating data linked output from research and investment reports to media content. Our enterprise offering can work in your cloud with our data engine to help you better understand your data.

records.name: HorizonsAI
records.tagline: Preview: verified travel companions + AI itineraries
records.description: Horizons AI matches you with verified travel companions heading your way and drafts a day-by-day itinerary together. This demo shows the core flow — companion matching, AI itinerary, safety verification, chat — ahead of full launch.

records.name: UnivNote
records.tagline: Study PDFs with handwriting, layers, and synced audio
records.description: When a textbook's printed page 1 is PDF page 7, renumber it to match. Then annotate with Apple Pencil, extend margins for calculations, hide solutions on layers, test yourself with answer masks, and tap ink to revisit synced lecture audio. UnivNote brings these tools together on iPad, iPhone, and Mac with an Apple-focused design and no AI features. Try 20 notes free; Unlimited Notes is $9.99 once in the US.

records.name: Fauxcation
records.tagline: Fake your vacation in China's most iconic spots with AI
records.description: Fauxcation is the first app built just for fake-vacation photos. Unlike AI portrait apps that beautify you, or sticker apps that paste you on a jpeg, Fauxcation generatively blends your selfie into real landmark scenes — matched lighting, matched perspective, done in 30 seconds. No account, no ads, no tracking. And a share-to-earn credit loop means the joke spreads itself. Results are labeled AI-generated: the fun is the joke, not the deception.

records.name: WorkKeeper: Field Report & PDF
records.tagline: Fast & easy PDF field report generator for teams and pros
records.description: WorkKeeper is designed for field workers, engineers, and inspectors to easily create detailed site reports on the go. Add photos, notes, and checklist items, then instantly export clean, professional PDF reports to share with your clients or team. Say goodbye to paperwork and save hours of manual report creation!

records.name: SEO Autopilot
records.tagline: SEO articles researched, written and published by AI
records.description: SEO Autopilot is an AI-powered SEO platform that handles the entire content workflow. Instead of combining multiple SEO and AI tools, you get one automated workflow from research to publication.

records.name: Prune
records.tagline: On-device iPhone cleanup. No cloud, no subscription.
records.description: Prune finds what's actually filling your iPhone — duplicates, screenshots, blurry shots, oversized videos, messy contacts — and lets you clear it one confirmed step at a time. Every scan runs on-device. No account, no server. Free 7 days, then $14.99 once.

records.name: ReviewAnalyzer
records.tagline: Free AI analysis of your Google Business reviews
records.description: Hey PH! I built ReviewAnalyzer because most small businesses have no idea what their Google reviews actually say beyond the star rating. Search your business, get an instant free AI analysis of your 5 latest Google reviews — sentiment score + top complaints, no signup needed. The paid Full Action Plan (₹499) analyzes up to 150 reviews with likely root causes, solutions, priority, and expected outcome per problem — AI-generated, no fabricated numbers. Would love your feedback!

records.name: Mouse4
records.tagline: Simple Windows screenshots without the clutter
records.description: Mouse4 is a tiny Windows utility for fast regional screenshots, automatic copy and local PNG saving, desktop pinning, and a handy File Explorer back shortcut. 14-day free trial; $4.99 lifetime license.

records.name: Stayfolio

records.tagline: Turn one music video into three editable Shorts
records.description: ChorusCut turns one finished music video into three distinct vertical clip suggestions. Pro users can add custom brand text and a PNG or WebP logo.

records.name: PinShot
records.tagline: Give camera photos a place on the map
records.description: Record a GPS track on your iPhone, then geotag photos, Live Photos and videos by capture time. Requires a matching recorded track and accurate timestamps. Free download with optional Pro subscriptions or a lifetime purchase.

records.name: Trisle
records.tagline: iOS 27's Triple Dynamic Island, now on Android
records.description: Trisle brings iOS 27's new Triple Dynamic Island to Android. Live Activities for music, calls, timers, and navigation appear as an animated capsule around your camera cutout, with three activities running at once, just like Apple's newest layout. Everything runs on device, no analytics, no tracking, no account needed. Five morph animations, six rim colors, full customization. One time purchase, 5.99 euros, no subscription, seven day refund. Over 1,000 already sold.

records.name: CodeSpotlight
records.tagline: Make your code impossible to miss.
records.description: CodeSpotlight makes selected code visually stand out in IntelliJ IDEA with customizable animated effects. Built for coding YouTubers, tutors, instructors, course creators, livestreamers, technical presenters, and anyone who wants their code to be impossible to miss.

records.name: ScamShield
records.tagline: Understand suspicious messages before you act
records.description: ScamShield is an AI-powered scam and phishing message analyzer that helps people spot threats before they act. It combines Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 with deterministic pattern checks to detect urgency, impersonation, suspicious links, payment requests, and social engineering. Instead of simply saying “scam,” ScamShield explains the evidence, risk level, and safer next steps.

records.name: Silverhold Post
records.tagline: Format your video posts for every platform, from one prompt
records.description: Silverhold Post takes one video description and instantly formats it correctly for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and Pinterest — titles, hashtags, tags, alt text, and board names, all matched to each platform's rules. Works two ways: a free offline formatter with no account needed, or connect your own AI key for freshly generated content per platform. One-time purchase, no subscription, works fully offline.

records.name: Fun Educational Games - KiddoJoy
records.tagline: Kids Learning Games, Coloring
records.description: Make learning a little more joyful with KiddoJoy! Explore a colorful world of animals, puzzles, music, and creativity. KiddoJoy brings playful learning activities together in one place, giving curious kids plenty of ways to discover, practice, and create.

records.name: VocalDoc Pro
records.tagline: Turn PDFs into audio. Read less, listen more
records.description: VocalDoc Pro turns PDFs and Word documents into natural-sounding audio while giving you powerful tools to read and edit documents on your phone. Choose from multiple voices and reading speeds, use background playback with lock-screen controls, manage pages, make document edits, and download audio for offline listening. Fast, private, and built for effortless productivity on the go.

records.name: Leakbook
records.tagline: See your subscriptions clearly. Decide what to keep.
records.description: Leakbook helps you track subscriptions and prepaid cards. No bank connections, no dashboards. Just clear summaries and email reminders before charges hit.

records.name: DocMind AI
records.tagline: The document AI that shows its work.
records.description: Upload any document — PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, or scanned images. DocMind gives you a summary, key points, and a plain-language explanation, grounded strictly in what's actually on the page. Every answer cites the page. If something isn't in the document, it says so instead of guessing. Handles scanned documents via OCR. Multi-provider AI (Gemini + Groq) so outages don't break your analysis. Free 30-day unlimited trial.

records.name: CancelBefore
records.tagline: Cancel your subscriptions before their next payments
records.description: CancelBefore — never pay for something you meant to cancel. Track subscriptions, get smart renewal alerts, and cancel before the charge. Upgrade to PRO to get cheaper alternatives on all your subscriptions.

records.name: 82Leads
records.tagline: Prospect research, outreach, and pipeline in one workspace
records.description: 82Leads brings prospect research, AI-assisted outreach, and sales pipelines into one workspace for agencies and SaaS teams. Research businesses, review personalized drafts, and run campaigns through your own email provider. Keep client workspaces separate. Explore the demo without an account, or try Starter free for seven days. Plans start at $15/month; AI and email-provider costs may apply separately.

records.name: Retro MP3 Jukebox
records.tagline: Turn your Windows PC into a premium retro jukebox
records.description: Retro Jukebox brings the classic 1970s audio-reactive neon aesthetics into a modern, touch-first Windows 10/11 application. First built in 2004 and now fully re-engineered for touchscreens, DIY cabinets, and 16:9 displays. 🎵 Native, bit-perfect FLAC, WAV, and MP3 local playback 🎵 4 animated neon light modes 🎵 100% Offline & privacy-focused—no ads or logins 🎵 Automatic aspect ratio and High-DPI UI scaling 🚀 Try it free for 15 days on the Store!

records.name: Talkasu: Rehearse Hard Talks
records.tagline: AI-powered communication training for everyday conversations
records.description: Talkasu is AI communication training for the conversations you dread. Rehearse asking for a raise, saying no, setting boundaries, or handling criticism—safely, privately, and on repeat. Each training starts with bite-sized lessons on what to say (and what to avoid). Then you roleplay with AI that stays in character and pushes back. After every message, get stars, fixes, and better wording. Finish with a full session score. Books teach theory. Talkasu builds muscle memory under pressure.

records.name: Saleshunt
records.tagline: Describe your ideal customer. Start closing.
records.description: Describe your ideal customer in one sentence. Saleshunt finds the companies that match, the right people to contact, and drafts outreach worth sending. It researches live sources instead of a stale database, learns from every reply, and goes deepest where US tools go thin: European markets. First 25 leads are free.

records.name: Pyrdo
records.tagline: Ask questions about your own lecture PDFs and slides
records.description: Most AI study tools answer from the open web. Pyrdo answers from the document you uploaded, and names the section it drew on, so you can check it rather than trust it. Upload a lecture PDF, essay or slide deck and ask in your own words. Maths is typeset properly, follow-ups stay in the same conversation, and it replies in English, French or Arabic. The free tier runs the same model as Pro — no cut-down version. Pro just raises the document size and daily limits. Free to start, no card.

records.name: Spoon
records.tagline: Windows Git client with AI commit messages
records.description: Spoon is a fast Windows Git client that uses the Git you already have. Clone, scan disks for repos, review diffs, and commit — with optional AI messages from Grok, ChatGPT, or Claude. API keys stay on your machine.

records.name: P-Ai
records.tagline: Track your whole portfolio, with an AI that explains it
records.description: P-Ai brings your stocks, ETFs, funds and crypto into one place — no more switching between four apps to see the full picture. An AI Analyst reviews your holdings and flags risk, allocation drift, and UK tax efficiency issues, in plain English. Free to track everything, forever — Pro unlocks deeper AI reports with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: InsTranscript
records.tagline: Instant Instagram Reel Transcripts with Zero Login Required
records.description: Generate accurate instagram transcript from Reels and videos in seconds. Transcribe instagram video to text, export SRT or TXT free with zero signup today!

records.name: TextTrace
records.tagline: Turn WhatsApp chats into searchable PDFs on your iPhone
records.description: Your client approved the work in WhatsApp. Keep that conversation with the project. TextTrace turns WhatsApp TXT or ZIP exports into searchable PDFs, CSV spreadsheets and HTML archives on iPhone. Find messages by person or date, then save a readable copy to share or print. Free to download; PDF and CSV exports require paid Pro.

records.name: EV Plug Finder
records.tagline: Find the right EV charger, faster
records.description: EV Plug Finder is a free tool that helps EV drivers quickly find compatible charging stations nearby. Beyond just locating chargers, drivers can report whether a charger is available and share what they paid to charge, giving the community more useful, real-world information before they arrive. We built EV Plug Finder to make public charging a little less frustrating and a lot more transparent. Try it at EVPlugFinder.com.

records.description: OpsBase is AI-powered lead intelligence: discover high-intent prospects from online conversations, score their intent, and start the right conversation.

records.name: 1VM
records.tagline: Run Linux, Windows, and macOS on your Mac
records.description: A local virtual machine desktop for macOS with QEMU built in. Download official Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, or Kali installers, import a ready-to-run 1vm machine, or boot Windows 11 and macOS guests. Every system gets its own window; machines live in ~/1vm and never leave your Mac.

records.name: OmniTools AI
records.tagline: Free AI Content Generator & Everyday Utility Toolkit
records.description: OmniTools AI is a free, fast, and light web utility suite. It includes an AI Content Generator for social/blogs/emails, EMI & Loan Calculator, Word & Character Counter, Password Generator, and SEO Meta Tag Generator. No sign-up required.

records.name: Reanroom
records.tagline: Every brand deal, link and payout in one place
records.description: Reanroom is where UGC creators run the business side of content: a deal pipeline from inbound DM to paid invoice, affiliate links with click tracking, a live media kit, a link-in-bio page, and Content AI that turns one video into a week of posts.

records.name: Blue Lantern Security
records.tagline: Security Platform for SMB
records.description: Continuous cybersecurity monitoring for SMBs and MSPs at a flat price per user. Protect email, browsers, and devices with predictable per-seat billing and no overage charges.

records.name: DevToolsCave
records.tagline: Free browser-based developer tools
records.description: DevToolsCave is a growing collection of 45+ fast, free developer tools for everyday tasks — from JSON, JWT and log viewer to converters, CSS tools, generators and visualizers. Built with a browser-first approach, many tools process your data locally for better privacy. No signup, no clutter, just useful tools that help developers inspect, transform, analyze and understand data faster.

records.name: MyCalCute
records.tagline: Free calculators for everyday decisions
records.description: A free calculator platform for everyday life, finance, business, dates, math, health, automotive and more. Search for the calculation you need, get clear results and formulas, save favourites, and install MyCalcute as a web app.

records.name: SIP Date Planner
records.tagline: One SIP date per fund, with an honest noise verdict
records.description: Most SIPs lock a date and never check it. This looks at a fund’s published NAV history, runs a monthly SIP on every day from the 1st to the 28th, and names the one with the highest XIRR. If the spread is tiny, it says noise, that’s a real answer, not a failed lookup. Free, no account, Indian mutual funds only. Not advice. Try a fund you already own and comment what felt unclear or wrong.

records.name: EasyStreak
records.tagline: Add streaks to your own products
records.description: Streak-tracking as an API for your product. Two lines of code, no cron jobs, no timezone bugs.

records.name: Reflectify
records.tagline: Turn AI conversations into clear personal insights.
records.description: Reflectify turns AI conversations into clear personal insights. Pick a reflection framework (Job or Personal), copy the guided prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you already use, and let it interview you - in your own language. When it hands back a structured JSON summary, drop it into Reflectify and get a beautifully designed reflection card: overall score, skill radar, first-person quotes, milestone timeline, goals, and wellbeing trend. Export as PNG or PDF.

records.name: Keirolabs
records.tagline: Web research infrastructure for AI agents
records.description: KeiroLabs gives AI agents and developers programmable access to the web. Search, extract, retrieve, and run multi-step research through APIs with structured citations. Its indexed search is designed for fast, low-cost agent loops, while content retrieval, embeddings, extraction, agentic research, and MCP support cover deeper workflows—from RAG pipelines to autonomous research agents.

records.name: Flip Hop
records.tagline: Daily On-chain Micro-Stake Game
records.description: Flip Hop is a global $5 daily on-chain micro-stake game. One round runs every day, with one winner and results anyone can verify on-chain. Randomness is powered by Chainlink VRF, settlement uses USDC on Base, and the smart contract is publicly verifiable. Simple mechanics, transparent results, no black-box draw.

records.name: Resolut
records.tagline: A privacy first, non-streak based porn recovery app.
records.description: Quit porn without telling anyone. Progress that does not reset to zero after a setback. A dedicated path for partners. Free for 21 days, no email required. 18+.

records.name: Scalar — build apps that last
records.tagline: A complete application foundation for AI development.
records.description: Build with AI. Keep your software maintainable. Scalar is an application foundation for AI-assisted development. Instead of starting from an empty repository, you start with a small, production-ready codebase that already handles the fundamentals — authentication, database, migrations, jobs, PWA, AI, and more. Scalar has its focus on simplicity as a foundation for complexity. The stack stays understandable, so your application can grow without software entropy making it harder to maintain.

records.name: Tastbudz
records.tagline: Find the place that defines the plate!
records.description: Tastbudz rates individual dishes, not restaurants. Find the best tacos, ramen, pizza and more across Southern California, ranked by the people who actually ate them.

records.name: ImAlive
records.tagline: Peace of mind for you, digital legacy for your loved ones
records.description: ImAlive gives you true peace of mind. Set a check-in timer (7, 14, 30 days). If you ever stop checking in, your encrypted digital legacy (credentials, private notes, memories) is securely delivered to your designated recipients.

records.name: Zipt Systems
records.tagline: Short links with real-time analytics and AI insights
records.description: Zipt is a link intelligence platform — shorten URLs, track real-time click analytics, and get AI-powered insights. Free forever, no credit card required.

records.name: EarlyBurd
records.tagline: A.I. powered deal hunting marketplace
records.description: Snap a photo of anything you want secondhand. EarlyBurd hunts every resale marketplace and alerts you the moment the best deal lands.

records.name: Destiny Script
records.tagline: Manifestation, written as your own cinematic story
records.description: Destiny Script turns your real goals into a personalised, narrated story set in the future where you've already achieved them, with journaling, future self letters, and vision boards built from your own words, not generic affirmations.

records.name: Softprobe
records.tagline: Performance reviews for AI Agents
records.description: See the work behind your agent’s answer. Capture and inspect your agent runs with unlimited session ingestion, unlimited agents, and 365 days of session history on the free plan.

records.name: BarqScan
records.tagline: Camera barcode scanning for the web — a Scandit alternative
records.description: Scandit-class barcode scanning for the web at a fraction of the price. EAN, UPC, Code 128, QR + 9 more, decoded on-device with WebAssembly. Free live demo.

records.name: API 653 inspection services
records.tagline: API 510, API 570, and API 653 inspection services
records.description: Chem-Ref-Services provides certified API 510, API 570, and API 653 inspection services for pressure vessels, piping systems, and aboveground storage tanks. We help industrial facilities maintain the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, and operational reliability through thorough inspections, integrity assessments, and industry-recognized best practices. With a commitment to precision, professionalism, and technical excellence.

records.name: Trading Metrics
records.tagline: Trading journal, analytics, screener, alerts & more
records.description: Trading Metrics is an all-in-one platform for traders to track, analyze, and improve their performance. Journal trades, analyze results, screen markets, scan technical patterns, set smart alerts, manage portfolios, and use built-in technical analysis tools—all in one place. Built for traders who want a structured, data-driven workflow without relying on multiple platforms.

records.name: PramitiHR
records.tagline: AI interview questions for freshers
records.description: DESCRIPTION: A practical guide covering the most common recruiter and candidate interview questions, sample answers, and how AI scoring evaluates responses. Built as a broad, long-tail content hub to grow PramitiHR's organic keyword footprint beyond its current single ranking term.

records.name: BondStats Pressure Vault
records.tagline: See what sovereign yields may be missing
records.description: Sovereign yields show what markets are pricing. Pressure Vault measures the financial pressure underneath and highlights where the two diverge.

records.name: ReachLoop
records.tagline: AI agent that finds your buyers and books your calls
records.description: ReachLoop is an AI sales agent for LinkedIn and email. Tell it who your buyer is and it finds ICP fit people including your competitors' most engaged commenters messages them from your own profile in your voice, follows up, handles replies, and books qualified calls onto your calendar. One tool instead of a database + sequencer + separate inbox. Built for founders and small teams who do their own outbound. Start free, then $79/mo.

records.name: Two Languages One Chat
records.tagline: Automatic WhatsApp translation for every conversation
records.description: Two Languages One Chat automatically translates WhatsApp Web conversations after you send a message. You write in your own language, while the other person reads it in theirs — and vice versa. No copying, pasting, or switching to a translator. It is designed to make multilingual WhatsApp conversations feel natural, fast, and simple.

records.name: ZeroMark
records.tagline: The fastest bookmark experience ever made
records.description: We provide the fasted bookmark experience. You clear years of saves in an afternoon. Inbox zero for bookmarks.

records.name: One Step Two
records.tagline: Gentle potty training, one small win at a time.
records.description: OneStepTwo helps families navigate potty training with less stress and more confidence. Track progress, spot patterns, build consistent routines, and celebrate every small win—all in a calm, parent-friendly app designed for real life with toddlers.

records.name: Logsblox
records.tagline: Agent-native SaaS with a full year of logs, at a low cost
records.description: Logsblox is agent-native application log storage priced on what you ingest. Flat 12-months of retention is included on paid plans — one tier, no retention fees, no infrastructure to run. OpenTelemetry native, so it fits the collectors you already use. Free to start: 500 MB/day, 14-day retention, one project, no credit card.

records.name: Acoustic Wall Panels Near Me
records.tagline: Premium Acoustic Wall Panels Australi
records.description: Discover acoustic wall panels near Australia, with stylish slatted designs that help improve interior aesthetics while supporting sound control. Visit us now!

records.name: LeafLog
records.tagline: Private plant care tracking without a subscription
records.description: LeafLog is a private plant care tracker that works offline in a single file. Track watering, fertilising, misting and repotting, see what needs attention today, and keep a care history for every plant. Unlike subscription-based plant apps, LeafLog requires no account, keeps your data on your device and is available as a one-time purchase.

records.name: Deepfake Detection
records.tagline: Catch the deepfake before it becomes a customer
records.description: Shufti catches AI-generated faces, face swaps, synthetic identities and document deepfakes using 40+ ensemble models, not basic image scanning. The engine reads skin texture, motion, lighting and depth irregularities, and detects the digital fingerprints unique to AI generators. Accuracy holds after compression, screenshots and stripped metadata. Three layers defend the session: capture integrity, liveness and forensics. iBeta Level 3 conformance, 0% APCER and 0% BPCER.

records.name: SimFuse
records.tagline: Travel data in 30 seconds, in 204+ countries
records.description: Buy a travel eSIM and get online the moment you land. Instant QR delivery, plans for 204+ countries, no physical SIM, no roaming bills. Pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay.

records.name: ClikDeo
records.tagline: Professional video editing tools for creators of all levels.
records.description: Free browser-based video editor, no watermark. Trim, merge, split videos & create YouTube Shorts locally. No sign-up.

records.name: Tivumo
records.tagline: Interactive maths games that make ideas click
records.description: Learn maths through interactive quests, visual challenges and rewarding progress. Tivumo is free, ad-free and built for students from Grade 1 to 12.

records.name: HappierMe
records.tagline: Feel calmer. Build happier relationships.
records.description: Build mental wellbeing through self-awareness with HappierMe. Develop emotional intelligence and life skills to reduce stress and strengthen relationships.

records.name: Kairoscope
records.tagline: The day as one circle: a planner for neurodivergent brains
records.description: Calendars show when. Kairoscope shows what the day costs. Your whole day is one circle — a month or a year too. Every event carries a weight, so it can say a day is full before you live it. Built for neurodivergent brains. When starting is the hard part, it offers one step and a two-minute timer, or breaks a task into 3-7 steps. Low-pressure mode rewrites the app, and its pushes, as offers not orders. The AI proposes, never decides: facts computed server-side, nothing applies unconfirmed.

records.name: Lushn.One - Chinese Astrology with AI
records.tagline: Discover Chinese Astrology & Feng Shui with AI
records.description: Chinese astrology is not simply a variation of Western astrology. It draws on a different traditional framework of time, seasons, Yin-Yang, and the Five Elements.

records.name: Graphene
records.tagline: The everything-as-code analytics platform built for agents
records.description: Graphene lets you do data analytics and visualization in your repo using your coding agent. Its novel semantic layer gives your agent the context and guardrails to query your data correctly, and its visualization framework lets your agent create gorgeous, live artifacts that you can share with your team.

records.name: AnthrAI
records.tagline: Validate your digital product with synthetic users.
records.description: Transform product testing with synthetic users. Validate your product and get user feedback before you launch.

records.name: Passport Photo Maker
records.tagline: Passport photos, exact sizes, zero uploads
records.description: Passport, visa and ID photos made entirely inside your browser — your photo is never uploaded anywhere. Pick a size (US 2×2, EU 35×45mm, Canada, China visa, or custom), position it with a live crop and positioning guide, adjust brightness/contrast, then download a JPG or PNG at the exact pixel dimensions you need. Supports iPhone HEIC photos with automatic conversion, plus a printable photo-sheet generator so you can print several copies at once. No account, no watermark, no limits.

records.name: Free Gift Card
records.tagline: Glow & Go Beauty Gift Card।
records.description: Glow & Go Beauty Gift Card.Not sure what to gift a beauty lover? Glow & Go is a digital $75 gift card that lets them choose what they love. Easy to share, flexible, and personal. Choose → Share → They Pick. What would make a digital gift card more useful for you? Explore: https://www.profitableratecpmnetwork.com/p8jatnqcw?key=a4e2c4ed3431c9c9f8e1c49163c6364e⁠�

records.name: See It Flow
records.tagline: Don't just learn how systems work. See them work.
records.description: You can't Google a concept you don't know exists. Many engineers never learn ideas like idempotency, backpressure, or CQRS simply because nobody ever pointed them there. SeeItFlow organizes system design, databases, and backend concepts into structured paths so you discover what's missing, then explains each one visually, through animated walkthroughs, diagrams, and text, so you can see the whole system's flow end to end. Free, no sign-in.

records.name: Cognumi
records.tagline: Managed AI operations for UK service businesses
records.description: Cognumi is a managed AI operations service — not a chatbot. A team builds and maintains your enquiry workflow, responds immediately to contact form submissions, portal messages, and emails (including evenings and weekends), and scores every lead Hot, Warm, or Cold before it reaches your inbox. Human review at every step. Live in 7 days. Month-to-month. Built for independent UK estate agents, private clinics, and mortgage brokers.

records.name: UK Pre-Seed Investor Hit-List
records.tagline: 115 verified UK pre-seed investors, with named partners
records.description: A hand-researched hit-list of 115 UK pre-seed investors — accelerators, angel networks, EIS/SEIS funds, micro-VCs. 62 official contact routes, each verified on the investor's own site. Top 20 ranked with the named partner who leads pre-seed, their thesis, and portfolio. No guessed emails.

records.name: Draf tDeul Pick Three
records.tagline: Pick three, share a link, see who matches your taste
records.description: Draft Duel is a casual pick-three social game. Choose three cards that feel like you, then share one link. Friends can answer in the browser — no account or install required for them. Play Mirror (they pick blind, then you compare matches) or Duel (they counter-pick from what’s left, then the group can vote). Create a badge, copy a verified link, or export a Story with a QR code.

records.name: CNA Professional Accountants
records.tagline: Smart Accounting Solutions
records.description: Bookkeeping, HST/GST filing, corporate and personal tax services for Ontario businesses and individuals. Accurate, year-round accounting you can count on.

records.name: Creator Scout by Tmarket
records.tagline: Find audiences that buy your product
records.description: Creator Scout is a matching engine that connects brands and creators. Describe your product and get matched with the creators whose audiences are most likely to buy it — or describe your channel and get matched with the brands that want to work with you. Filter by platform, region, or brand, save your best matches into collections, and let AI turn your brief into a ready shortlist.

records.name: InfinitumView
records.tagline: Bring your screens and media into Apple Vision Pro
records.description: InfinitumView brings compatible HDMI/UVC sources and local photos and videos into Apple Vision Pro. View flat, 180° and 360° media, or connect the separate InfinitumView Companion for Mac, iPhone and iPad for local screen sharing. The current apps are free to download. Windows and Android companions, remote connections and advanced controls remain in development or on the roadmap.

records.name: Omni Player by OmniSubs
records.tagline: Media player with AI Subtitle - 100% Local. No Subscription.
records.description: Meet Omni Player, the Windows video player that helps you understand more of what you watch. Open local films, anime and podcasts—or supported YouTube and video links—and generate subtitles from speech in real time. See the original alongside up to two translations, explore useful expressions in context, and review them with quizzes built from each session. AI processing runs locally on your PC, with no cloud upload, subscription or per-minute fees. Watch, translate and learn in one place today.

records.name: gather: RSS News Reader
records.tagline: RSS for iPhone and Android. No login, no unread guilt.
records.description: An RSS reader for iPhone and Android with no login required. Two feeds: Browse for everything, Keep up for the few sources you never want to miss. Clean reader view, offline queue, and optional summaries that run on your device.

records.name: Toddler Coloring Games
records.tagline: Baby Drawing & Painting Book
records.description: Kids Coloring App is a fun and easy painting app for toddlers and young children. Kids can color cute animals, vehicles, nature scenes, dinosaurs, and many other fun pictures while learning and being creative. The app includes simple drawing tools, bright colors, stickers, and a kid-friendly interface designed for little hands. Children can draw, paint, color, and save their artwork to enjoy later.
